Main.GameStats.Title: Hearthpulse sends your games to its own statistics
Main.GameStats.What: After matches and Arena draft decisions, Hearthpulse sends a cleaned game journal: visible offers and choices, cards and actions, resources, board state and the result. It helps refine statistics and reprocess past games. Only observed events are available; gaps are marked separately. Your Battlegrounds games, including those from the last 30 days, and your card picks (Discover and the like) in Ranked and Casual games also go into the public totals of the stats pool and are kept there for 60 days.
Main.GameStats.Never: No name, BattleTag, account, deck name or Legend number; no hidden hand, deck or shop of other players. Journals are kept on the Hearthpulse server for up to 180 days with a random install identifier, separately from your site account. Only totals across many players are published. “Turn off” stops both the journals and the stats pool; later there are two switches in Settings → Data. The journal queue is cleared and their deletion retries until the server confirms it; games in the pool are not deleted on request and expire after 60 days.
